purpose: Teach: ジョナサン/ジャカルタ/草津/マイアミ/ロースト/ニーチェ/のび太/ワトソン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ジョナサンの絵本のシリーズ好きだったな
lines.en: Hey Riku, you used to love that Jonathan picture book series, didn't you?
lines.style: Playful tease with genuine memory underneath. Casual, testing—leaning back. Slight smile in the voice. Eyes bright with the pleasure of catching him in something.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ジャカルタの地理勉強したな、桜
lines.en: You studied the geography of Jakarta pretty hard, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Even-toned comeback, deflecting with his own observation. Not defensive—matching her energy. A small acknowledgment that he notices what she does too. Quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で草津温泉行ってたな
lines.en: Riku, your family took that trip to Kusatsu hot springs, remember?
lines.style: Lighter now, drawing him in rather than poking. Genuine curiosity mixed with affection. Pace relaxes slightly. The tone of someone who actually paid attention to his stories.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、マイアミの留学パンフ集めてたな、桜
lines.en: And you were always gathering those Miami study-abroad pamphlets, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Softer than his first comeback. Still matching her move, but with less edge. The observation feels tender now—like he's been paying attention to her dreams too. Slight pause before her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ローストポテト食ってばっかだな
lines.en: Riku, you're always eating roasted potatoes. That's basically your whole diet.
lines.style: Wry and affectionate. Quick rhythm, slight exaggeration for effect. A smile underneath the sarcasm. The tone of someone comfortable enough to mock without sting.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、倫理でニーチェ習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You learned about Nietzsche in ethics class, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Matching her wryness now with his own observation. Light, almost playful. The name at the end lands softly—familiarity. Not challenging, just remembering alongside her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、のび太の絵本あったな
lines.en: There were those Doraemon picture books at your place, weren't there, Riku?
lines.style: Gentler rhythm. Slower, more reflective. The memory feels genuine now. Eyes softer. Drawing him closer rather than keeping distance. The tone of someone admitting she's been inside his home and remembers.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、シャーロック・ホームズのワトソン推しだったな、桜
lines.en: You were always really into Watson in the Sherlock Holmes stories, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Close and steady. Voice lowers slightly—drawing her in. The observation is intimate, specific. No performance. Eye contact level. The tone of someone who watches and remembers what matters about her.
